facts.fact: El Chaab says the National Digital Transformation Strategy was adopted, approved and published in May 2025, naming no approving body or act.
El Chaab says the strategy was published in May 2025 as the reference framing national digital projects for the coming years, and states no end date.

El Chaab says the High Commission for Digitalisation was created to prepare national digital-transformation policy and follow the programmes that deliver it, coordinating sectors and public bodies; the three-year review covers April 2024 to September 2026.

The High Commission published a review of April 2024 to September 2026 on its official page listing the strategy, sovereign cloud, secure government network, data centres and the national digital services centre inaugurated on 5 July 2026; it reports no strategy targets.
